en.title: Gulfstream flies first fully outfitted G400 as certification program advances
en.summary: Gulfstream has started flight-testing the first G400 fitted with a complete passenger cabin, another step toward certification of the business jet, showcased at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas. The 11-passenger cabin spans two-and-a-half living areas, and the flight from Dallas Love Field lasted 2 hours 46 minutes and reached 48,000 feet.
body: Gulfstream has started flight-testing the first G400 fitted with a complete passenger cabin, taking another step toward certification of the new business jet as it showcased the aircraft at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas. The aircraft flew from Dallas Love Field for 2 hours and 46 minutes, reaching 48,000 feet; its 11-passenger interior, arranged across two-and-a-half living areas, will allow Gulfstream to evaluate cabin systems and passenger comfort in flight. The G400 first flew in August 2024, more than two years ago, and has since undergone high-altitude testing in Telluride, Colorado, and cold-weather testing in Iqaluit, Canada. It is powered by two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW812GA engines.

Another G400 traveling to the show set a Miami–Las Vegas speed record, completing the trip in 4 hours and 8 minutes at an average speed of Mach 0.89, using a blend of sustainable aviation fuel. "The aircraft continues to perform exceptionally well as we advance through the rigorous certification program," Gulfstream President Mark Burns said. Gulfstream introduced the G400 in 2021 with a base price of $34.5 million and has not announced a revised certification date. The company lists projected range at 4,200 nautical miles at Mach 0.85 with eight passengers, three crew and fuel reserves, and a planned maximum operating speed of Mach 0.90; cabin layouts seat nine, 11 or 12 passengers, with sleeping space for up to five in the largest configuration and 10 oval windows. The Symmetry Flight Deck offers touchscreen controls and active control sidesticks, plus a landing-performance system designed to help pilots recognize runway overrun risk on approach.

zh.title: 灣流G400首架完整客艙試飛機升空、邁向取證
zh.summary: 灣流航太已開始以首架裝設完整客艙的G400進行試飛，為這款商務噴射機的取證再進一步。該機由達拉斯愛田機場起飛、飛行2小時46分鐘、最高達4萬8000英尺，11人座客艙橫跨兩個半起居區；另一架G400則以平均0.89馬赫創下邁阿密—拉斯維加斯速度紀錄。
body: 灣流航太已開始試飛首架裝設完整客艙的G400，朝這款新商務噴射機的取證再邁進一步，該機並於2026年拉斯維加斯NBAA-BACE展會亮相。試飛機由達拉斯愛田機場起飛，飛行2小時46分鐘、最高達4萬8000英尺；11人座客艙橫跨兩個半起居區，讓灣流得以在飛行中評估客艙系統與乘客舒適度。G400於2024年8月首飛，至今已逾兩年；該機配備兩具普惠加拿大PW812GA發動機，並歷經科羅拉多州特柳賴德的高海拔測試與加拿大伊魁特的寒冷氣候測試。

另一架前往展會的G400則創下邁阿密—拉斯維加斯速度紀錄，以平均0.89馬赫、4小時8分鐘完成航程，並使用永續航空燃料混合油。灣流總裁Mark Burns表示，該機在嚴格的取證計畫中持續表現出色。G400於2021年推出、基本售價3450萬美元；原廠尚未公布修正後的取證時程。性能方面，原廠標示在8名乘客、3名機組員與備用油量條件下，航程4200海里（0.85馬赫），最高操作速度0.90馬赫；客艙可選9、11或12人座配置，最大配置可供5人過夜，10扇橢圓窗引進自然光。駕駛艙採用Symmetry Flight Deck觸控控制與主動側桿，並配備協助飛行員辨識衝出跑道風險的落地性能系統。
